Monologue: Svetka is absolutely seething today, and so is Izolda. It makes it difficult to do paperwork, so I'm going for a bit of a sortie.
The rebels attacked them today, and I fear Izolda is a— mild Svetka fanatic. You see, she used to have a bit of a thing for one of the royals.
But she discovered that they were- well, like all the rest, and was just furious with herself for trusting them.
Svetka used that- she tends to use people. Had Izolda chop off the royal's heads one by one so she'd look like some kind of pacifist in comparison.
That bastard is a stellar leader. Outside, Aijinkova is improving- the people prosper, and no one goes hungry.
People love her. Our Lady Serebryakova and her indelible generosity. A firm and just patriot who loves her country. The perfect leader.
I almost hope someone kills her.
